char_4132_ascln.name: Ascalon
char_4132_ascln.description:
Deals Damage to <@ba.kw>all targets</> within range
50% chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks and is less likely to be <@ba.kw>targeted</> by enemies
char_4132_ascln.itemUsage: S.W.E.E.P. Supervisor Ascalon—the fog of the war, the smoke of the fire, the one who pounces when the time is right.
char_4132_ascln.itemDesc: Guess how long she spends right behind you. Now guess higher.

reviewedContracts: Ordinary uncapped WALK CAST attacks select one original Attack_A/B variant. Both actual facing hit events are .7s with source maxAnimScale1.
S1 exact original additionalTimes1/waitAttackEventForAllAttacks1 yields two separate .7/.967 Skill_1 hit events; source selected ranks retain all ten charge/ATK rows.
S2 native duration wrapper has waitForAttackEvent0/preDelay0, aura targetMotionALL and source death callback explicitly narrows WALK before circle-range transfer. Skill_2 attacks use .933 OnAttack.
S3 actual mode aliases Attack to Skill_3_Loop and Idle to Skill_3_Idle, with original .933 strike. Source additive BAT, ATK and taunt attributes and WALK hit-rate aura are retained.
Talent2 CheckHeightTypeInRange x-5 is a source ON_BUFF_START one-time condition, not a continuously re-evaluated terrain effect.

blockers.reason: Original ApplyBuff waits for an attack event but the verified original literal Begin has no OnAttack. No executable native dispatcher or explicit timer recovered; neither immediate attachment nor .5s animation-end release is certified.

blockers.mechanism: Attacker physical and Arts hit-rate reduction
blockers.reason: Source modifies attackers rather than target dodge. Its owner healing distinguishes ON_EVADE_DAMAGE from ON_TAKE_DAMAGE cancellation reason HIT_FAILED. Engine target dodge alone cannot stand in for this source behavior.

Raw CreateBuff triggerInterval2 coexists with selected source interval1; maxStackCnt1 coexists with selected max_stack_cnt3. The source blackboard-bound controller is not executable here. S2 preprocess copies talent interval/stack/duration into the selected skill blackboard, preserving exact source fields but not proving their native override ordering.

limitations: All native source and numeric selector/formula/variant fields are preserved; source model events do not recover the native C# dispatcher.
No partial generic kit is registered while these whole-kit behaviors are unresolved. Original Unity poison/smoke/particle effects and modules remain excluded.
